metadata.title: Global rigidity of sphere packings in constant curvature background geometry
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we study the dual characterization of conformal tetrahedra in constant curvature spaces, which develops a geometric technique to obtain the global rigidity of hyperbolic, Euclidean, spherical and ideal hyperbolic sphere packings on a tetrahedron. Moreover, we establish the extended variational principle to obtain the global rigidity of the (ideal) hyperbolic sphere packings on 3-manifolds. We also generalize the conformal tetrahedra to higher dimensions and provide a characterization of conformal $n(\ge3)$-simplices in constant curvature spaces, which is useful for studying higher-dimensional sphere packings.

analysis.workSummary: 用共形四面体的对偶刻画证明常曲率背景球堆积刚性，并将变分原理推广到三流形。
analysis.breakthrough: 统一多种背景几何并给出高维共形单形刻画。
analysis.limitations: 四面体刚性与三流形全局结论须分开，高维刻画不自动给出全部堆积刚性。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
analysis.priorityReason: 离散曲率及几何变分直接相关。
